name: mind
description: Persistent AI memory and personal knowledge graph. Query, remember, and manage your MIND from Claude Desktop — memory, tasks, contacts, research, and more.
long_description:
MIND is a personal knowledge graph AI memory platform. This bundle connects Claude Desktop to your MIND knowledge graph over stdio, giving Claude persistent memory across every conversation: query your knowledge graph, store memories and decisions, manage tasks and goals (Focus → Project → Outcome → Task), track contacts and CRM, run deep research, read your emotional context, and more — all backed by your own MIND account at m-i-n-d.ai.

Get a MIND API key at https://m-i-n-d.ai → Settings → Developer → API Keys, install this bundle, paste your key when prompted, and Claude Desktop has full access to your MIND.

tools.name: mind_query
tools.description: Search your MIND knowledge graph — semantic + graph reasoning over your stored documents, entries, and feed posts.

tools.name: mind_remember
tools.description: Store facts, decisions, learnings, and research into your MIND knowledge graph.

tools.name: mind_context
tools.description: Load identity, operating rules, priorities, and recent activity from MIND.

tools.name: mind_life
tools.description: Manage Focus → Project → Outcome → Task hierarchy — MIND's life/task management surface.

tools.name: mind_crm
tools.description: Track contacts, log activity, and manage relationships in MIND's CRM.

tools.name: mind_graph
tools.description: Inspect knowledge graph stats — entity count, relationship density, graph health.

tools.name: mind_research
tools.description: Run a deep research agent against a topic and store the synthesized findings.

tools.name: mind_tasks
tools.description: Create, update, and complete standalone tasks tracked in MIND.

mind_api_key.title: MIND API Key
mind_api_key.description: Get your key at m-i-n-d.ai → Settings → Developer → API Keys

mind_base_url.title: MIND Base URL
mind_base_url.description: Optional — only set this if you run a self-hosted MIND instance. Leave default for the standard m-i-n-d.ai account.
